These are the most common commands used for opening basic shell interfaces.

### Core Functions

| Function | Command | Description |
|----------|---------|-------------|
| **Launcher** | `ipc call launcher toggle` | Open/close application launcher |
| **Control Center** | `ipc call controlCenter toggle` | Toggle control center visibility |
| **Settings** | `ipc call settings toggle` | Toggle settings (General tab) |
| **Settings Tab** | `ipc call settings toggleTab $tab` | Toggle settings on a specific tab |
| **Open Settings** | `ipc call settings open` | Open settings (General tab) |
| **Open Settings Tab** | `ipc call settings openTab $tab` | Open settings on a specific tab |

> **Settings tab parameter**
> `$tab` is a tab name (case-insensitive, hyphens/underscores ignored): `general`, `bar`, `dock`, `wallpaper`, `color-scheme`, `user-interface`, `control-center`, `desktop-widgets`, `launcher`, `notifications`, `osd`, `lock-screen`, `session-menu`, `audio`, `display`, `network`, `location`, `system-monitor`, `plugins`, `hooks`, `about`.
>
> Append `/$subtab` to navigate to a specific subtab index, e.g. `settings openTab bar/2`.


### Quick Access

| Function | Command | Description |
|----------|---------|-------------|
| **Clipboard** | `ipc call launcher clipboard` | Access clipboard history |
| **Emoji** | `ipc call launcher emoji` | Quick emoji selector access |
| **Command** | `ipc call launcher command` | Quick command runner access |
| **Windows** | `ipc call launcher windows` | Window switcher access |
| **Settings Search** | `ipc call launcher settings` | Settings search access |
| **Calendar** | `ipc call calendar toggle` | Open/close Calendar window |
| **Session** | `ipc call sessionMenu toggle` | Logout, reboot, shutdown... |
| **Lock** | `ipc call lockScreen lock` | Launch the lock screen |
| **Lock & Suspend** | `ipc call sessionMenu lockAndSuspend` | Lock screen and suspend system |
| **System Monitor** | `ipc call systemMonitor toggle` | Open/close system monitor |
